scope: archived public or synthetic regional spatial snapshots

metrics.measure: features with source and capture references

waiver_rules: Every non-zero warning requires a recorded reason and affected feature count.
A release-blocking failure cannot be waived by an agent panel alone.
Rights uncertainty remains a separate publication gate.
non_claims: This contract defines bounded quality thresholds; it is not evidence of national completeness or real-council qualification.
Missing coverage is pending, not negative evidence.
